title: Growth vs Cash
desc: Compare the APY of a brokerage against a standard checking.
to-teach: Maximize APY using a brokerage account.
hints: Checking yields 0% APY while the brokerage yields an expected 8% APY.
Create a brokerage account and transfer $3,000 of dormant checking funds into it.

client.name: Marcus
client.description: Marcus has accumulated idle checking capital that is losing ground to inflation instead of compounding.
client.prompt: I have $4,000 sitting in checking earning nothing. Can you move $3,000 into a brokerage account to earn market returns?
